bug_info.bug_desc: In FLUSH, a general debug-entry request overrides the DBG_TAKEN_ID destination selected for a prioritized EBREAK with privilege-appropriate debug entry enabled. Concurrent halt or single step therefore selects DBG_TAKEN_IF and saves IF PC/cause instead of the EBREAK instruction PC and EBREAK cause.
bug_info.fix_hint: Retain the EBREAK-selected DBG_TAKEN_ID destination when ebrk_insn_prio and ebreak_into_debug are both true; apply the general enter_debug_mode override otherwise. EBREAK re-entry while already in debug mode must continue to leave debug CSRs unchanged.
